thread:
billing-bot: ALERT: billing-metering mismatch detected for last 2h, token delta > 7% across >50 customers. auto-pager -> #incidents.
ops-bot: Pager triggered to oncall-metering. escalation path: maya -> jake -> samir.
maya: On it. joining channel. quick ask: is this counting drift or delayed emits? any cbk from emitter logs? :eyes:
jake: seeing elevated 'emit_retry' in emitter-proxy logs around 2026-03-15T02:12Z. also consumer lag spiked on kafka-partition-7.
samir: noted. priority: 1) prevent new false overage flags 2) triage root cause 3) start customer recon.
maya: immediate mitigation: flip billing-shadow to read-only (no new flags) and enable aggregator-fallback v2. running: `./scripts/flip_shadow.sh --mode read-only --reason "investigating drift"`
ops-bot: RUNBOOK: metering > mitigation -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift (see "preventative flags").
lina: running quick query to count divergence, posting results. `SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens_emitted) AS emitter_tokens, SUM(tokens_ingested) AS ingested_tokens FROM metering.kafka_window WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY emitter_tokens - ingested_tokens DESC LIMIT 50;`
maya: great. while that runs, can someone scope customer impact? @customer-success-amy please flag any high risk customers.
customer-success-amy: pinged top 20 customers on the watchlist. one customer (AcmeCorp) reported a spike in overage emails at 02:30Z. they asked to pause billing flags.
jake: I can temporarily mute flagging for affected customers via `billing.admin.mute_flags([cust_ids])`. prepping list from query.
samir: root cause hypothesis: emitter-proxy retries were writing duplicate intermediate events and consumer dedupe logic misfired due to metadata TTL on the dedupe store. when consumer restarted it replayed offsets causing double-count for some windows.
lina: query results: top diffs show approx +9-12% extra tokens in emitter_tokens relative to ingested for ~53 customers. delta concentrated on partitions 5-8.
maya: mitigation checklist: 1) mute new overage flags (done) 2) enable aggregator-fallback (in progress) 3) deploy quick dedupe-patch to consumer (hotfix) 4) schedule reconciliation/backfill job for affected window 5) customer comms template
jake: hotfix build passing. deploying `metering-consumer@hotfix/dedupe-ttl-rollback` to canary 2 nodes now: `kubectl -n metering rollout restart deploy/metering-consumer-canary`
ops-bot: DEPLOY: `metering-consumer@hotfix/dedupe-ttl-rollback` started by jake at 2026-03-15T02:48Z.
samir: after canary looks good (10m), promote to main. also recommend running `reconcile_counts.sh --window "2026-03-15T00:00:00/2026-03-15T03:00:00" --mode dry-run` first to estimate adjustments.
maya: starting dry-run. output sample: `AcmeCorp: emitter 1,234,567 tokens vs ingested 1,112,345 -> delta 122,222 (10.98%)`
customer-success-amy: drafting customer note: short, apology, immediate mitigations, ETA for final reconciled invoice. will share in #customer-notifications for review.
jake: can we prevent duplicate counting in future? propose: 1) increase dedupe TTL to cover max retry window 2) emit idempotency token include producer timestamp 3) add metric to detect consumer replays (offset-reset counter)
lina: adding metrics: `metering.consumer.replay_detected{partition}` and `metering.dedupe.misses`. will wire alerts for >1% delta in 30m rolling window.
ops-bot: NOTE: created incident ticket INC-2026-1583 in PagerDuty with severity P2.
maya: status update: hotfix promoted at 02:58Z, canary healthy. mute remains. dry-run completed. scheduling backfill for 03:30Z (low traffic window).
samir: backfill plan: run reconcile in dry-run, then --apply with rate limit 2000 tokens/s, monitor latency SLOs. rollback plan: pause apply and re-enable shadow flags.
jake: starting backfill job in 30m. will stream logs to this thread. command: `./reconcile_counts.sh --apply --window "2026-03-15T00:00:00/2026-03-15T03:00:00" --rate 2000 | tee backfill.log`
maya: customer impact summary for CS: ~53 customers with 5-12% overcount for a 3hr window. likely overage emails triggered for ~12 customers. estimated $$ impact small but needs apologized credit. agree on templated credit: one-time credit equal to overage charges for the window + short apology.
customer-success-amy: ack. will hold outbound comms until after reconciliation confirms deltas.
ops-bot: BACKFILL: job started by jake at 2026-03-15T03:32Z. logs: `INFO Reconcile: processing partition 5 offset 1203456-1206789` (streaming).
lina: monitoring reconciler metrics; memory/CPU within normal. reconciliation progress ~30% after 8 minutes.
jake: mid-run note: encountered 1 partition with schema mismatch; paused apply for that partition, flagged for manual repair. moving on to next partition.
samir: good catch. schedule separate small window for that partition. do not apply global credits until final reconcile completes.
maya: post-mortem action items (prelim): - long-term: make dedupe TTL auto-adjust based on max retry window - add runbook section for 'mute flags' procedure - automate backfill dry-run estimator - better customer impact tagging when flags are emitted
customer-success-amy: once we have reconciled numbers I'll send targeted notes and a small goodwill credit for the affected accounts.
ops-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated (hotfix deployed, flags muted, backfill running). tagging oncall: maya. next: postmortem capture and billing reconciliation ticket to finance.
maya: closing loop here — will create postmortem doc and link to this thread. thanks everyone for quick responses. :heart:
